editorialPolicy.statusRule: Published means a complete JSON article already in content/articles and all three translations; planned topics do not generate site pages.
editorialPolicy.draftLength: Target 1200-2200 useful words per substantive article in primary language, with fully edited Arabic, English and French versions; factual quality outweighs arbitrary length.
requirements: Original research and examples, not content spinning
Verified dated sources and copyright-compliant visuals
Internal links to related published content
Author/date/revision notes and appropriate financial disclosures
No fabricated testimonials, earnings or token listing claims
editorialPolicy.cadence: Planning capacity 6 thoroughly edited trilingual articles per week, conditional on verified sources and QA, not a publication guarantee.
